name: comfy-mobile
description: Mobile-first web UI for selecting and running ComfyUI workflows

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @comfy-mobile/server" "npm run dev -w @comfy-mobile/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @comfy-mobile/web && npm run build -w @comfy-mobile/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @comfy-mobile/server && npm run typecheck -w @comfy-mobile/web
